name: THL-Vorlage
style_text: Editorial illustration in a limited palette: bright vermilion red, black ink, pure white background, soft grey shading. The background is flat white, no paper texture, no cream or beige tint. Loose ink linework with painterly red brush strokes, splatters, and scattered black and red dots as graphic accents. Figures sketched, often in red clothing or black silhouette. High contrast, modern, slightly abstract. No text, no letters, no logos.
